[Teorema de Pasinetti]{.tag}

<h2 class="h">

<a href="pasinetti.qmd">Por que a poupança dos trabalhadores não muda a taxa de lucro</a>

</h2>

::: deck
<p>O Teorema de Pasinetti (1962) demonstra que a taxa de lucro de longo prazo depende apenas da propensão a poupar dos capitalistas e da taxa de crescimento.</p>

```{=html}
<style>
.noticia-slide { animation: fade 0.8s ease-in-out; }
@keyframes fade { from { opacity: 0.3; } to { opacity: 1; } }
.dots-container { text-align: center; margin-top: 2.2rem; padding-bottom: 1rem; }
.dot { cursor: pointer; height: 10px; width: 10px; margin: 0 5px; background-color: #d9d9d9; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; transition: background-color 0.3s ease; }
.dot.active, .dot:hover { background-color: #b3001b; }
</style>
```

```{=html}
<script>
let slideIndex = 1;
let timer;

function mostrarSlide(n) {
  clearTimeout(timer);
  let slides = document.querySelectorAll('.noticia-slide');
  let dots = document.querySelectorAll('.dot');
  
  if(!slides || slides.length === 0) return;

  slides.forEach(s => s.style.display = "none");
  dots.forEach(d => d.classList.remove("active"));
  
  slideIndex = n > slides.length ? 1 : n < 1 ? slides.length : n;
  
  slides[slideIndex - 1].style.display = "block";
  if(dots[slideIndex - 1]) dots[slideIndex - 1].classList.add("active");
  
  timer = setTimeout(() => mostrarSlide(slideIndex + 1), 7000);
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  timer = setTimeout(() => mostrarSlide(2), 7000);
});
</script>
```
